entries.proposition: WWOX protein was measured in L1CAM-captured, neuronal-enriched plasma extracellular vesicles as one analyte of an Olink Target 48 Neurodegeneration 41-plex, reported as relative NPX on a log2 scale, not absolute concentration.
entries.snippet: Results were reported as normalized protein expression (NPX) values. NPX is Olink’s relative quantification unit, expressed on a log2 scale. NPX measures relative change.

entries.proposition: Neuronal enrichment is an immunocapture operation on L1CAM, not a demonstration of neuronal origin.
entries.snippet: The second step entails purifying nEV using L1CAM antibodies for selective affinity capture.

entries.proposition: The Olink assay was run in singlet, unlike the duplicate Luminex and electrochemiluminescent assays.
entries.snippet: Proximity extension assays were performed on the nEV lysates in singlet per manufacturer’s instructions

entries.proposition: WWOX was treated as normally distributed and analysed by one-way ANOVA with Tukey correction.
entries.snippet: For data that are normally distributed (EIFAK2, NPTX2, WWOX), horizontal bars represent group means and 95% confidence intervals as determined by ordinary one-way ANOVA followed by Tukey tests to correct for multiple comparisons.

entries.proposition: The paper states WWOX was higher in men than in women within the same cognition group.
entries.snippet: and WWOX (WW domain-containing oxidoreductase) were higher in men than in women for the same cognition group
entries.anchor: Results 3.4, Discriminating Between Sex and Between PWH Cognition Groups

entries.proposition: PANEL READING. In Figure 5B the WWOX panel with the sexes combined carries NO significance bracket across the four cognition groups, and in the sex-split panel exactly ONE bracket is drawn, between two male groups. The whole WWOX result is a single marked comparison within one sex, on an NPX axis running about -1.0 to 1.0 with group means between about -0.25 and 0.0.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 5B, WWOX panels: upper panel (HIV-, NPN, ANI, MND combined) shows no significance bracket; lower panel (M then F, four groups each) shows one bracket with a single asterisk spanning two male groups, with the later male group mean lower; all means lie between about -0.25 and 0.0 NPX.
entries.qualifies_needle: higher in men than in women for the same cognition group

experimental_context.endpoint: Olink NPX in L1CAM-captured plasma EVs

entries.proposition: In men, WWOX is one of five nEV proteins differing between the three HIV cognition groups, and the authors read it as a redox protein acting with GLRX on tau.
entries.snippet: In men, we found the proteins that are differentially expressed between the three HIV cognition groups were NCAM-1, tTau, GLRX, NPTX2, and WWOX.

entries.proposition: WWOX entered a two-predictor logistic model with NCAM-1 in men; the published odds ratios for WWOX carry confidence intervals spanning or nearly spanning 1 in two of three comparisons.
entries.snippet: Multiple logistic regression using main effects model for NCAM-1 plus one other protein to discriminate between cognition groups in males.
entries.anchor: Table A1 caption and its block 'Discrimination Between Groups (NCAM-1 and WWOX)'

entries.proposition: The authors call the study exploratory and hypothesis-generating, not confirmatory for any single marker.
entries.snippet: this exploratory study was not designed to provide confirmatory evidence for any single biomarker

entries.proposition: The cohort is people with HIV and seronegative controls, with co-morbidities excluded; no WWOX genotype is involved anywhere.
entries.snippet: A total of 140 age-matched plasma samples were selected from the MACS/WIHS Combined Cohort Study (MWCCS). Participant recruitment, characteristics, and NP testing information have been published previously
entries.anchor: Methods 2.1, Study Participants and Plasma Collection
